findings.summary: Migrate-failure branch no longer increments `failed`, silently undercounting failures.
findings.mechanism: In the refactored migrate case statement, the `*)` (non-201/409) branch dropped `failed=$((failed + 1))` that existed pre-change. The final summary `echo "created=... failed=${failed}"` and the trailing `[[ "$failed" -eq 0 ]] || exit 1` gate now never see migrate failures, so the script can print `failed=0` and exit 0 even though repos failed to mirror — masking real migration errors from cron/alerting.
